altTexts: The Runes workspace with the etch action
The etch form with symbol, divisibility, and pre-mined amount
The etch payment summary with the service fee itemized
stepInstructions: Open the runes workspace and choose Etch to declare a new rune.
Set symbol, divisibility, and any pre-mined amount. These are permanent declarations.
Check the payment summary: pay-to-anchor chain fees plus the flat service fee, itemized separately.
